caption: The drawing shows two objects positioned horizontally on a plain, off-white background. The upper object is a sword with a slightly curved, metallic blade that has shades of grey, blue, and brown, and a detailed handle featuring a golden or brass-colored guard and pommel, with a dark grip wrap. The lower object is a matching scabbard depicted parallel to the sword, primarily brown with metallic highlights and two metal rings positioned at intervals along its length for attachment, with the tip end flaring outward and both ends having a metallic finish. Below the objects, handwritten text in pencil or grey ink reads: "CIVIL WAR SWORD AND SCABBARD" and underneath that, in smaller letters, "ENGRAVED... N. DAMES. CUTLER. SPRINGFIELD 1839."
title: Sword and Scabbard
